liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ocean Man** (1 review): Gene's nephew, or someone like that, stood in on this song [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **pre-encore crowd**: rare: 4 archived performances [8]
- **ween sucks**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]

## The recordings

- **ween2006-05-28.mk4v.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 24 songs; 95 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording is pretty nice, but in some spots certain instruments or the vocals are mixed too quietly [6]
- **ween2006-05-28.mk4v.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 94 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound at the Ween set was weaker than earlier sets that day, though it could have been far worse [7]
- **ween2006-05-28.mbho.flac24**: source not stated; 24 songs; 95 min [3]
- **ween2006-05-28.mbho.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 95 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer rates Ween the best set of the festival day, ahead of the Dirty Dozen and RRE, thanks to Gene's stage presence [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2006-05-28.mk4v.flac24**: source: schoeps mk4v > vms02ib > edirol r4 (24/96) [1]
- **ween2006-05-28.mk4v.flac16**: taped by sleepypedro (pwking); transferred by sleepypedro (pwking); source: schoeps mk4v > vms02ib > edirol r4 (24/96) [2]
- **ween2006-05-28.mbho.flac24**: taped by sleepypedro (pwking); transferred by sleepypedro (pwking); source: mbho 603a/ka500hn > edirol r4 (24/96) [3]
- **ween2006-05-28.mbho.flac16**: taped by sleepypedro (pwking); transferred by sleepypedro (pwking); source: mbho 603a/ka500hn > edirol r4 (24/96) [4]
